messages.subject: Path problems referring to an app
parts:
Dumb question sorry

Following on from 
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shinyapps-users/markdown/shinyapps-users/2QRxxROQ8sw/-8Jw7jn6yEYJ

I have created an rmarkdown file and placed it in a MyShinyDocs folder. It deploys to

http://pssguy.shinyapps.io/MyShinyDocs/mdTest3.Rmd

everything works fine if I refer in the markdown document to a system.file
shinyAppDir(
  system.file("examples/06_tabsets", package="shiny"),
)


I currently have an app deployed at http://pssguy.shinyapps.io/mdTestApp/
so I want to do something equivalent

shinyAppDir(
" ../mdTestApp"
)

but it states there is no shiny app on that path
tried a few other variants with no success but sure I am missing something really simple

tia

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Path problems referring to an app
parts:
Hi Andy,
Shinyapps is designed to be a distributed platform for the deployment of shiny applications.  Each application is completely self contained and runs within it's own "mini virtual machine".  The best way to think about may well be to think of every deployment of every app running on its own computer.  We manage the setting up, configuration, running, and shutdown of those computers on your behalf.  

There is no shared filesystem that you can leverage today, but it might be a feature we would consider building in the future should the demand justify it.
Best,
-Tareef

OK. I had hoped to have some sort of rmarkdown file that would act as a blog. Each entry might have a separate app related to it. This does not seem feasible currently

Locally, I have a folder 'testFolder', which has within it a markdown file 'markdownTest' and a shiny app, '06_tabsets' (from the shiny examples)

```{r, echo=FALSE}
shinyAppDir(
 "'06_tabsets"
)
```
